caseName: North American Bond Trust v. Commissioner
caseNameFull: North American Bond Trust, City Bank Farmers Trust Co., Trustee v. Commissioner of Internal Revenue
attorneys: Mr. Claude A. Hope for petitioner. Solicitor General Fahy, Assistant Attorney General Clark, and Messrs. J. Louis Monarch and Michael H. Cardozo, IV, for respondent.

opinions.text:
Petition for writ of certiorari to the Circuit Court of Appeals for the Second Circuit denied.

Mr. Justice Douglas took no part in the consideration and decision of this application.
